conflicts.remarks_quote:
This property is valid only if both are true:

- [[IFillPatternFeatureData::FeaturesToPatternType]] = [[swFeaturesToPatternType_e]].swFeaturesToPatternCreateSeedCut

- [[IFillPatternFeatureData::CreateSeedCutType]] = [[swCreateSeedCutType_e]].swCreateSeedCutDiamond
conflicts.why: swCreateSeedCutType_e 枚举 0=None、3=Diamond；示例显式设 CreateSeedCutType=0 后立刻写 Diagonal，与 Remarks 要求的 Diamond(=3) 相反。
枚举 0=swFeaturesToPatternSelectedFeatures、1=swFeaturesToPatternCreateSeedCut；示例最终设为 0，按 Remarks 此时 Diagonal 无效。

example_more_specific.what: 示例按米给值：Diagonal = 0.008 即 8 mm，并与 FillPattern 的 Diameter 同值；成员页未写单位。

results.note: CreateSeedCutType=0 在 Diagonal 之前显式赋值，不依赖默认值；FeaturesToPatternType=0 一条说的是建特征时的最终状态。
